decisions.decision: Energy cost data (oil, diesel, gas) for Town buildings is to be uploaded to the Mass InSight website; the goal is to have all of it by the next meeting so a baseline year can be set and a plan developed. Street lights are excluded because the Town does not own them.
decisions.quote: all energy cost ( oil, diesel, gas) for the town buildings needs to be uploaded to the mass insight website

decisions.decision: The draft vehicle use/replacement policy was sent to all departments with vehicles and the Town Manager for review; the goal is to replace all non-exempt vehicles within 10 years within the Capital Plan.
decisions.quote: it was sent to all departments with vehicles and the town manager for review.

decisions.decision: Stretch Code will not be increased, because the energy code has been increased significantly in the new building code.
decisions.quote: because the energy code has been increased signiﬁcantly the stretch code will not be increased.

decisions.decision: D. Blatt will speak with the Town Manager about whether the group should be called a "task force" or a "committee".
